80451.subject: ⚡ Claude's cheapest model beat GPT-6 Luna
80451.body:
----------
######           [Subscribe](https://academynews.genai.works/)   -    [Collaborate with us](https://utm.genai.works/r/cq9vsh4)


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Claude's new cheap model costs the same as OpenAI's, and Anthropic says it beats it on every test they share. ChatGPT launches a version for teens. Google will now make you a video game if you describe one. And MIT used AI to keep a vaccine working for two months without a fridge.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Anthropic:** What does your Claude Max plan get you for free now?

* **OpenAI:** What did ChatGPT tell a teen tester who said they talk to it too much?

* **Google:** Can you really make a video game without writing any code?

* **MIT:** How did AI keep a vaccine alive outside the fridge?


----------







----------
## Claude's new cheap model beats OpenAI's at the same price

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/af681d09-78e1-426e-81b1-2d52b1ef3cf9/Oct_8_-_1.jpg?t=1791449665)
Caption: 

Anthropic [released Claude Haiku 5.5](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-haiku-5-5), the cheapest small model it has ever released. It's priced the same as GPT-6 Luna, OpenAI's budget model, and Anthropic says it beats Luna on every test the two share.

Haiku is Claude's smallest and fastest model, built for jobs that need to be quick and cheap. The last one came out almost a year ago.

* It costs about 75% less to run than the last Haiku, by Anthropic's math.

* Anthropic says that in a few areas it rivals Sonnet 5.5, which costs 20 times as much.

* It can take in five times more text at once than the old Haiku.

* Artificial Analysis, the independent benchmark site, also ranked it above Luna.

It writes about three times as much as Luna at full effort, so the same price won't always mean the same bill.

If you pay for Claude Max, Anthropic is also giving you **free API credit every month**, $100 on the $100 plan and $200 on the $200 plan. It's for building with Claude's API and doesn't roll over. It rolls out this week.

Last week we told you an early tester claimed Haiku would ship next, with Fable a week later. Haiku showed up. Let's see about Fable.


----------







----------
## 

### Your agents work while you sleep

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/90c9ba2e-4b3b-4979-a273-46787c2045d5/Secondary_Ad_1.png?t=1787254795)

80448.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1136

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Thursday! Today, we’re diving into Meta & Sierra's new Personal Agent Protocol (PAP) to see what it tells us about who gets to vouch for AI agents and who will own agentic payments (why Amazon cutting off Meta's Muse set it off, how PAP's business-issued tokens differ from Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol [ https://substack.com/redirect/dadfd0f8-02aa-436d-90b9-7ebab49ff048?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & Google's Universal Commerce Protocol [ https://substack.com/redirect/9042657a-2055-46c9-83a3-338b393dcb81?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], & what to watch for next + bonus deep dives into Claude Commerce Agents, or Anthropic’s Merchant-Side Bet on Agentic Commerce [ https://substack.com/redirect/2b6c54b4-c8d3-4633-81e9-fa6b5756b7f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], & a16z’s State of Markets 2026: The AI Playbook for Founders and Investors [ https://substack.com/redirect/55287f49-adfe-425b-932b-87902c1f3be7?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and breaking down Musk's decision to let Grok Bot [ https://substack.com/redirect/48bbab16-e2c5-4450-9a9f-50e362af4242?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] run on Claude, Midjourney & Suno to see what it tells us about where the AI agent race is actually being won (why SpaceXAI is now treating its own Grok models as a replaceable part, what it means for the model-agnostic agent startups whose whole pitch is routing across labs, the data question SpaceXAI still hasn't answered, & what to watch next + bonus deep dives into Sequoia’s Private AI Briefing, or why AGI Is Already Here [ https://substack.com/redirect/0884e7c3-5e7e-45c2-94f6-b2c90b0654e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & How to Build Your First AI Agent from Scratch [ https://substack.com/redirect/b8325b39-b3e0-4300-bc74-b5e8bc78a776?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the finnovative stuff 🌶️
Meta’s Personal Agent Protocol just opened the fight over who controls Agentic Payments 🤖💳
The BIG News 🔥 Meta $META  and Sierra’s Personal Agent Protocol (PAP), announced October 6 and backed by Stripe, Shopify, and Walmart, puts the business in charge of vouching for a consumer’s AI agent. In other/rival designs, Visa, Mastercard, or the AI platform does it.
This matters because whoever vouches for the agent controls customer data and liability in agentic commerce and, eventually, also collects fees on agentic payments.
Most importantly, the biggest fight now is over a payment clause that hasn’t been written yet, and it will be what settles whether Stripe and Shopify or the card networks own the credential every AI agent carries.
Let’s dive in, understand why i
